name: diet COPT options
comment: New COPT options and native parameters; writes copt_out.par

options.copt_options: alg:nlptol=1e-9 bar:start=1 lp:barorder=2 pre:solve=4 mip:fapheurlevel=2 mip:startnodelimit=10 lim:multiobjtime=100 tech:optionnative 'Presolve 1' tech:optionnative 'RelGap=0.001' param:write=copt_out.par

comment: Simplex and tolerance options of HiGHS 1.15.1 with their MP-style names

options.highs_options: alg:simplex=4 alg:simplexscale=3 alg:simplexcrash=2 alg:simplexdualedge=1 alg:simplexprimaledge=1 alg:simplexupdatelim=1000 alg:feastol=1e-8 alg:dualfeastol=1e-8 alg:opttol=1e-8 pre:solve=on tech:threads=1 tech:seed=7 lim:iter=10000

name: knap_40 HiGHS MIP options
comment: MIP options of HiGHS 1.15.1 with their MP-style names

options.highs_options: mip:gap=1e-6 mip:gapabs=0 mip:intfeastol=1e-7 mip:heureff=0.1 mip:symmetry=0 lim:nodes=1000 lim:sol=100 mip:lpsolver=simplex mip:heur:rins=0 mip:heur:feasjump=0 mip:restart=0 mip:nodecuts=1 mip:poolagelimit=20 tech:miplogfreq=1

name: Check_Rejected_Param_Value HiGHS
comment: Value outside the HiGHS option range: abort before solving, the message names the AMPL option

name: diet SCIP LP options
comment: LP and technical options of SCIP 10.0.2 with their MP-style names; native parameters inline; writes scip_out.set

options.scip_options: alg:method=d alg:remethod=p lp:pricing=s alg:feastol=1e-8 alg:dualfeastol=1e-8 lp:scaling=2 pre:solve=1 tech:threads=1 tech:seed=7 lim:iter=10000 lim:rootiter=10000 tech:clocktype=1 tech:optionnative 'lp/checkstability=1 display/verblevel 0' tech:optionnativewrite=scip_out.set

options.scip_options: mip:gap=1e-6 mip:gapabs=0 mip:symmetry=0 lim:nodes=1000 lim:sol=100 cut:gomory=5 cut:cover=-1 cut:clique=0 alg:emphasis=5 heu:settings=1 pre:settings=0 sol:poollimit=3 lim:bestbndstop=2000 tech:outlevnative=0
